dogecoin.text: I’m not holding $doge but happy for the holders with this pump. There should be no hate for the OG memecoin!

Will $DOGE be worth $20 a coin? 

Can it become as big as $ETH? 

Could $XRP be worth $50 a coin? 

Will #Fartcoin make me rich?? 

We all need to look at total supply vs market cap to manage our expectations and be more logical about what is possible.
@Ashcryptoreal $DOGE has had enough and refuses to be treated like a stepchild any longer.
